title: kate-core: list the tabs from left to right
summary: views_in_order walks the split tree and returns every view id from the left pane to the right pane. A single leaf returns its tabs in stored order. The test goes in the existing workspace tests module. This waits for PKT-0247.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: workspace.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Add views_in_order on impl SplitTree. Add #[cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code))]. A leaf returns a copy of its tabs. A split returns the first child, then the second child. Do not nest an if inside an if.  Do not write two if arms that return the same value. Combine them with ||. That is clippy::if_same_then_else. Do not touch split_after or activate. The existing test activate_shows_the_named_tab stays green. Do not rewrite its assertions. The test views_in_order_lists_the_leaf uses workspace, new_document, and add_view twice. views_in_order equals a vec of the first view id then the second view id. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines. Stay inside this one behavior. Run the full test module named in the commands, not only the new test.

regression_tests.name: workspace::tests::views_in_order_lists_the_leaf
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because views_in_order does not exist. After the change two tabs in one leaf come back as the first view then the second view.
